the futures session

Despite the closure of the regular session, a significant divergence was noted on the NDX index: the price fell by (-0.34%), however, the cumulative CVD energy flow on the cash market shows accumulation at a level of 54.69 M, suggesting passive absorption of supply during the session.

The situation is complicated by strong negative Nasdaq broad market radiation (TICKQ = -323.00), which, with the SMA200 average at 116.39, indicates strong selling pressure in the index structure.

  • QQQ options analysis: The options market shows moderate implied volatility (IV: 20.60%). The Put/Call Volume Ratio at 0.97 suggests balanced sentiment between buyers and those hedging positions. The market-expected range of movement for QQQ lies within the 714.04 – 727.70 range with an options volume of 6.19 mln contracts.
